verdict.rationale: Document text extraction is a fair question for a web-scraping API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions extracting text from PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint files. The extraction features shown (extract_rules, ai_query, return_page_markdown) all operate on HTML web pages, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself
